## Body

PRD 009 s04 merged (#351, main cc995a6c). Review finding B351-R1-01 (pij-official-aardwolf, BLOCK): the first turn said "Carries authority" from the TYPE's flag. Authority comes only from the role id: `holders::seat_role_for` (pa, pm, pm-<n>, else worker), the function assign stamps the seat role with. Fixed in a5778a19: the line reads "Carries authority: yes|no, as your role's id makes you a <pa|pm|worker> (a type grants none)." Lesson: never derive authority from meta.type or TypeDef::authority() anywhere a seat is told what it may do; the type is a label. Prove such fixes with a mutant (put def.authority() back; the release-helper/pa case must fail).

Remaining 009 work: only the pods page (req-05), after PRD 008 (#346) merges: a docs/cli/pods.md page (or generated from the pod template catalog if 008 compiles one in), listed in crates/cli/src/docs.rs pages(), the concepts "Coming" section trimmed for what 008 ships, req-05 shipped and workstream 009 s03 complete.
